title: Cowduction
duplicate_check: No matching host in prior-urls.json, catalog-baseline.json published_games, or previously_seen_urls; confirmed in the prior dedupe pass.
controls_actions: Selected JOGAR SEM LOGIN (play without login), then INICIAR A AVENTURA for mission Nebulária 1-1; skipped the opening intro.
Used W and Space during the active level; the UFO moved from center-right to a higher position, and the HUD changed from CASCO 5/5 to CASCO 4/5 while the level remained active.
Watched the enemy line and asteroid field continue animating; HUD showed beam energy, force, META 0/8, and corridor progress.
gameplay_outcome: Direct gameplay was verified through player movement and a responsive in-level HUD. The ship took one hit (hull 5/5 to 4/5); score and mission target progress remained 0 during the brief test, and the mission was not completed.
mechanics: Side-view arcade space action. The menu advertises WASD or arrow movement and Space for the beam. Mission Nebulária 1-1 displays a UFO with a cow pilot, small green ground characters/enemies, a beam-energy meter, hull/armor, and target/corridor counters.
visual_art: Original illustrated sci-fi scenes with a purple nebula and planet, futuristic city, UFO/cow pilot, and bright green alien-like figures; the active scene has a wide side-on battlefield and prominent HUD.
existing_custom_cover_evidence: The title screen shows a bespoke COWDUCTION logo and game-specific painted space/UFO/cow artwork. No separate promotional cover asset was verified.
thumbnail_concepts: Text-free close-up of the determined cow pilot under the UFO dome as a bright green beam lifts a surprised green alien from a purple nebula planet.
The cow's UFO streaking above a glowing alien battlefield, with a huge violet planet and multiple green figures creating a dramatic rescue-or-capture moment.
screenshot_note: Title and active gameplay screenshots were captured and shown inline in the CUA output; this subagent CUA surface exposes no supported local screenshot-file export.
audio: Parent verified the macOS output-mute checkbox is enabled; no native audio settings were changed by this tester. This test tab was closed after the session.
